event:
I withdrew the finding, and the verdict was accepted.

The warm-reset test never checks an interrupt: it only reads the hardware status bit after the single-bit ECC injection. But I found nothing in the repository that ties plan item p1.k2 (the ECC interrupt to the MCU) to that test. I didn't open the plan spreadsheet itself, so a link could still exist there.

`smoke_test_mcu_mbox_ecc.c` does check the single-bit and double-bit ECC interrupts and fails if they aren't set. That test covers the interrupt half of the plan item.

I changed no files. The plan row for p1.k2 should point at `smoke_test_mcu_mbox_ecc`.
